title: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium
visualBrief: Specific Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in neutral football configuration: own native oval envelope/smaller lower bowl opening and separate picture-estimated larger roof aperture, pale staggered projecting silver panel skin/rounded ribbed crown/west entrance glazing, supported radial roof frame/curved stays and paired inner cable ring/glazed leading strip, continuous single-bank South Stand and multi-bank side/north stands with closed hospitality belts/pale aisles, large convex south glazed atrium with two visible branching tree supports/owned floors and contacts, four supported neutral corner displays/football field/goals and small original roof cockerel/ball silhouette. Six existing shared graphs plus image-free transparent PBR glass for actual visibility through the atrium/roof; no private textures/copied crowd/event/seat graphics/furnished hidden rooms/whole precinct slab. The static field does not implement a moving/NFL conversion system.
